form.label: Collector health
form.description: See API failures, ingestion delay, collection volume, and missing heartbeats.

search.query: `zabbix_events` earliest=-7d | stats count by instance | fields instance

div.p: See API failures, ingestion delay, collection volume, and missing heartbeats.

html.p: No heartbeat can mean a disabled input or stopped Splunk. Configure the supplied saved searches and the external Zabbix agent health check. Errors retain the affected checkpoint; other streams continue.

search.query: `zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:collector | stats latest(status) AS status latest(error) AS error latest(lag_seconds) AS lag_seconds latest(count) AS rows latest(duration_seconds) AS duration_seconds max(_time) AS last_seen by instance input_name stream | eval heartbeat_age_seconds=now()-last_seen | convert ctime(last_seen)

| tstats sum(Collector.count) AS rows FROM datamodel=Zabbix_Operations.Collector WHERE Collector.instance=$instance|s$ BY _time span=15m Collector.stream | rename Collector.stream AS stream | timechart span=15m sum(rows) by stream
`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:collector | timechart span=15m max(lag_seconds) by instance
